en: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves, that we are underlings.
zh: 亲爱的勃鲁托斯，我们屈居人下，错不在命运，而在我们自己。
line: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves, that we are underlings. — William Shakespeare

word.zh: n. 浸，湿透，大雨；vt. 使上下湿透，浸，吸入，吸收
word.ex: He was soaking wet from head to toe.
